players.product: Ceramic housings and aluminium nitride ceramic substrates for optical communication modules

quarterly_data.signal: CFO, deputy general manager and board secretary Dong Hui (H1 2026 results briefing): at the end of the reporting period the revenue tied to contracted but unfulfilled performance obligations was RMB 26.49 hundred million.
quarterly_data.figure: remaining performance obligations RMB 26.49 hundred million

quarterly_data.signal: Results briefing: executive deputy general manager (acting general manager) Liang Xiangyang said Q2 2026 revenue did not rise much over Q1 mainly because the delivery acceptance and revenue-recognition timing of some customer orders was spread unevenly across quarters, a normal fluctuation; orders are full and utilisation high. CFO Dong Hui said inventory rose from the start of the year because the company built strategic raw-material reserves, expecting continued order growth and raw-material price swings, and that operating cost grew faster than revenue mainly on higher gold and non-ferrous metal prices.

Other businesses (results briefing): Liang Xiangyang said that in precision ceramic parts the company has fully mastered electrostatic-chuck materials, design and process, reaching international peer level, passing user validation and supplying in volume; its electrostatic-chuck parameters benchmark international peer products, have passed users' on-tool validation, and several products have entered volume supply. Subsidiary Hebei Bowei kept revenue growing in H1 2026 while profit was slightly pressured by product mix and higher R&D; it has serialised GaN RF chips and devices for 5G-A base stations in industrial production with a leading domestic share (company claim) and holds key technologies for 6G and satellite communications. Plans: SiC focused on new-energy vehicles, PV and storage, industrial and grid markets; GaN RF toward 5G-A, satellite internet, low-altitude security and counter-drone uses; building 8-inch wafer and packaging / test capacity; subsidiary Xiongan Taixin's R&D focus is core chips for test and measurement and for high-speed communications.
